Number two, the consideration of an insurance program like we have for grain as an example for cover avian flu and then number three is outside the congress but if we have another outbreak both the industry in the government has had learned a lot from this first outbreak and we've got to be we've got to have better biosecurity at each farm if we're going to prevent the spread and there's been a lot learned by both the farmers as well as the Department of Agriculture on certain precautions that need to be taken.
